facts.fact: Vice President Victor Bockarie Foh formally launched the national open data portal opendata.gov.sl on 2015-05-15, fulfilling a June 2014 OGP commitment; the World Bank assessment says its strategy, governance and management were not yet set.

The World Bank readiness assessment of November 2015 says few datasets had been uploaded to the portal since launch, and names only the NERC Ebola care facilities list as released under an open licence (CC-BY).

The World Bank assessment of November 2015 says the strategy, governance and project management of the open data initiative were still in flux, and it recommends introducing open data provisions in the policy and legal framework; it names no open data policy.
